proposals.title: Instagram profile on a phone, earnings card rises over it: “$100–$500 just from that video”
proposals.why: The whole ig1 comp: phone flies in from the right while the profile scrolls to the reel grid (sticky tabs), a light card rises 32 px as the phone blurs to 6, a green ↗ springs in, the amount builds in two hard cuts and the tail words drop in.
proposals.call: igProfileEarnings(comp, {at, low: "$100", high: "–$500", tail: "just from that video", lowAt: 2.9333, highAt: 3.6667, tailAt: 4.5333, arrowColor: "#73c98f", cardColor: "#f6f7f9", username: "yournamehere", name: "Your Name Here", posts: "883", followers: "14.1K", following: "1 000", bio, highlights: ["About", "Catalog", "Price", "Reviews", "Location"], time: "9:41", scroll: [197.5, 790], stickAfter: 650, blur: 6})

proposals.title: Spring pop driven by an expression (65 → 113 → 95 → 100 %)
proposals.why: Green trend arrow: scale = 1 − 35·cos(2.6·2π·t)/e^(5t) % from frame 25, opacity hard-cut on, position compensated so it grows around its own centre; no keyframes, so the cue is one number.
proposals.overlaps: pop (keyed 115/95 spring with a fade): could be pop(layer, {curve: "spring"})

proposals.title: Words drop in from above, fading, left to right
proposals.why: just from that video: animator Position [0, −35] + Opacity 0, range selector by words, Ramp Up, ease high −50 / low 100, offset −100 → 100 linear over 1.03 s.
proposals.overlaps: none (text entrance; stagger works on layers, this on words inside one layer)

proposals.title: Text chained to the right edge of the text before it
proposals.why: “$100” sits 8 px right of the spacer text and “–$500” right after “$100” (sourceRectAtTime), so the amount builds left to right whatever the widths.

proposals.title: Small soft rise into place with a quick fade
proposals.why: The card rises 32 px in 0.43 s on 33 % out / 70 % in while fading in over 0.18 s: a calm arrival, not a slide.
proposals.overlaps: slideUp: better as slideUp options {distance, duration, outInfluence: 33.33, inInfluence: 70, fadeIn: 0.18}

proposals.title: Background blurs as a card lands on it
proposals.why: The phone precomp's Gaussian blur goes 0 → 6 over 0.83–1.10 s exactly as the card arrives, pushing focus to the card.
proposals.overlaps: defocusIn (dj3) is the reverse move (blur → sharp)
proposals.previewNote: Cropped to the card (the phone kept as context) rather than full frame, so the 6 px blur stays visible at GIF size.

proposals.title: Scroll a long page inside a matte, with a sticky bar
proposals.why: CTRL - Reel scroll's “Scroll (px)” slider (197.5 → 790 in 1.17 s) moves every child up; CTRL - Sticky tabs follows until “Tabs stick after” (650 px) and then stays, like a real app's sticky tab bar.
proposals.call: scrollRig(comp, {layers, sticky, matte, from: 197.5, to: 790, at, duration: 1.1667, stickAfter: 650})
proposals.previewNote: Layers are #n stack positions in the phone precomp (some names contain commas or repeat): the scrolling children, the sticky tabs, both CTRL nulls and both mattes; the fixed header and screen are kept as context. Bezel PNGs are Mac-only, so the phone shows without its frame.

proposals.title: Phone flies in from the right while its screen scrolls, then lifts
proposals.why: Phone precomp x 2340 → 1452 in 0.85 s (33 % out / 70 % in) while the profile scrolls inside, then lifts 85 px over 1.0–1.55 s (33/65) to make room for the card.
proposals.overlaps: slideUp (other direction and easing); scrollRig does the inside motion

proposals.title: Editable Instagram profile screen
proposals.why: Fixed header (status bar, username, verified dot), stats, bio, buttons, highlight circles, sticky tab bar and a reel grid built from rows repeated every 326 px: a ready app screen to put in a phone.
proposals.call: instaProfileScreen(comp, {username, name, posts, followers, following, bio, link, highlights, rows: 5})
proposals.overlaps: phoneMock holds it; scrollRig scrolls it
proposals.previewNote: Layers are #n stack positions in the phone precomp (every screen layer, no bezel). Shows the first 0.5 s, where the profile header, bio, buttons and highlights are on screen.

proposals.title: Phone frame with a UI screen inside
proposals.why: ig1's phone: PNG bezel with a camera pill, rounded 731×1565 matte screen holding an editable app screen.
proposals.previewNote: No useful isolated preview: the bezel and camera are PNGs (Asset 5_3x 1_24-398.png / 24-545.png) that only exist in Elias's Mac Motion Library cache; rebuilt here the part is a plain white rounded screen. The whole-comp GIF is kept.

proposals.title: Light earnings card with a green ↗ and an amount
proposals.why: 792×124 rounded card #f6f7f9 with a soft 10 px shadow and CC Vignette edges, a 2.8 px #73c98f ↗ at the left and grey Roboto 26 amount text.
proposals.overlaps: none (dj3 statCard is the dark version); pairs with springPop, trailingLabel, wordDropIn
